item.description: This option sets the picture brightness. 0 is the receiver's own setting.
This option sets the picture contrast. 0 is the receiver's own setting.
This option sets the picture hue. 0 is the receiver's own setting.
This option sets the picture sharpness. 0 is the receiver's own setting, -100 is off.
This option sets the picture saturation. 0 is the receiver's own setting.
This option sets the HDMI colour space. auto picks the best one for each resolution; 2160p 50/60 Hz always uses YCbCr 4:2:0.
